behavior.target: Check global reservations and unknown sends before allocating another slot.
behavior.assay: Compare a source-bound card capsule against matched factual instructions on held-out tasks. Freeze carrier, tools, budget and evaluator; record constraint violations, useful outcomes and operator corrections. See /cards/behavior-assay.json.

runtime.note: Source engineering maturity is a historical author assertion, not fresh runtime evidence.

art.prompt: Original HFO editorial science-fantasy. Obsidian, restrained crimson light, ivory highlights, etched technical geometry, tactile mineral and archival-paper textures. Vertical 4:5, one clear central silhouette, quiet crop margins. No text, numerals, logos, badges, evidence stamps, franchise characters or recognizable franchise art. Conceptual illustration only. Subject: ChatGPT Account B on Oracle. Show layered terrain and bounded reservoirs connected by measured channels. Express the intended role without depicting deployment, victory or authority.
art.alt: Planned conceptual illustration for ChatGPT Account B on Oracle; no artwork generated.

behavior_contract.intent: Candidate behavior: turn a named capacity surface into an evidence-based allocation recommendation.
behavior_contract.when_to_use: When selecting capacity for a bounded task or explaining why it should wait.
inputs: Admitted capacity observation and its validity conditions
Shared-pool reservations, unresolved sends, task demand and budget ceiling
procedure: Identify which routes draw on the same quota pool.
Reconcile reservations and unresolved sends before estimating usable headroom.
Compare the task's requirements with currently evidenced capacity.
Recommend the smallest sufficient allocation or a queue/recheck action, with an expiry condition.
outputs: Allocation recommendation with assumptions and source timestamps
Unresolved-capacity list and next observation needed
failure_modes: Counting two routes as two independent quotas
Treating unknown sends as unused capacity
Raising a cap to make a task fit

example.situation: Two possible worker routes share one quota pool.
example.action: Account for their combined reservations and recommend one task-fit route.
example.evidence: Expected: a capacity calculation tied to current observations; no account or host values in public output.

neurosymbolic.neural: Match the task's needs to available options.
neurosymbolic.symbolic: Track shared capacity, reservations, ceilings and observation freshness.

frozen: Pool identity, budget caps and episode authority
evolution.fitness: Evaluate correct allocation recommendations under fixed stale-data and shared-pool cases, without claiming capacity from labels.
